rule: Each class lists series ids (as world_model.load_inputs names them) from DIFFERENT sources that measure ONE quantity. The representation forge publishes, per cross-source pair, the spread, its z-score and the first member conditioned on the disagreement state. A member absent on this box is reported by name, never imputed. Add a class here when a second source of a quantity is ingested.

eur_usd_spot.why: the ECB euro reference rate (14:15 CET concertation) and the Federal Reserve H.10 noon buying rate price the same exchange rate at different instants from different institutions

us_policy_rate.why: BIS central-bank policy-rate statistics (the USD leg of the EURUSD row) and the effective federal funds rate published by the Federal Reserve both measure the US policy stance
